change.summary: A documented 204 No Content with an empty body silently became 200 OK with a JSON body {workflow_run_id, run_url, html_url}. Clients testing for 204 as the success signal treated every successful dispatch as a failure. Pinning X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28 did not prevent it.

spec.note: GitHub publishes a spec and pins an API version header, and neither helped: the rollout was unintended and went out under the pinned version. The versioning mechanism that exists precisely to prevent this did not.

changelog.note: The changelog entry appeared 2026-02-19, two months AFTER developers hit it, and describes an opt-in parameter — confirming the December behaviour was an accidental default-on rollout. Ship first, announce later.

contract.note: The archetype for this technique: status 204 to 200, empty body to a three-key object. One scheduled call against a throwaway repo, diffed on status and top-level key set, catches it on the first poll.

notes: GitHub's own Ruby SDK broke on GitHub's own API. Staff confirmed in-thread that it had gone live by accident; the behaviour was reverted around 2025-12-22 and the docs were later retrofitted to match. Lead time is structurally impossible here — the only available win is detecting it in hours instead of hearing it from users.
